card.name: Slowing, pausing or reducing treatment
card.fires_on: Words about slowing, pausing or cutting back treatment, such as rate after reduce infusion, temporary, temporarily, pause, interruption, reduced. Seen in dosage-modification instructions for reactions.

modes.label: Infusion rate changes
modes.description: The word rate after reduce, decrease or slow, about infusion.
modes.example: Reduce infusion<< rate>>, interrupt infusion or permanently discontinue G

modes.label: Temporary stop or pause
modes.description: Words meaning a short halt or interruption of therapy.
modes.example: Hemopoietic toxicity may warrant<< temporary>> suspension or cessation of therapy with dacarb

modes.label: Reduced dose or frequency
modes.description: Words for lowering dose or how often a product is used.
modes.example: reduce the<< frequency>> of the application of TWYNEO
